服务端网关配置说明\n\n一、监听与暴露\n- gateway.port / g:
Server Gateway settings

Listen address and exposure
- gateway.host / gateway.port control the HTTP listen address.
- allow_public_bind defaults to false to prevent exposure without a proxy or tunnel.

Security and skey
- auth_enabled requires Authorization: Bearer <skey> for protected endpoints.
- Enter a name and optional expiration date to generate a skey. The original key is shown only once.
- skeys stores enabled, skey_hash, masked skey, name and expiration. Original keys are never stored.
- Disabled skeys cannot authenticate requests.
- Enable trust_forwarded_headers only behind a trusted reverse proxy.

Rate limits and idempotency
- webhook_rate_limit_per_minute limits webhook requests per minute.
- rate_limit_max_keys limits tracked client keys in memory.
- idempotency_ttl_secs / idempotency_max_keys control webhook idempotency caching.

Node Control
- node_control.enabled enables the experimental node-control API.
- node_control.auth_token is an additional shared token sent as X-Node-Control-Token.
- Empty node_control.allowed_node_ids means no explicit allowlist; * allows all nodes.

Recommended defaults
- Use host 127.0.0.1.
- auth_enabled defaults to false; configure skeys and enable authentication before exposing the service.
- Keep allow_public_bind disabled.
- Trust forwarded headers only in a controlled proxy chain.

技能配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- skills 用于控制技能系统加载来源与系统:
Skill configuration guide

1. Purpose
- skills controls skill discovery sources and system prompt injection.
- The upper configuration section controls loading; the catalog shows skills and their sources through the gateway service.
- These settings affect context length and skill visibility.

2. Page structure
Skills
- Switch between project and all directories. Skills are grouped by project, ancestor, global and built-in sources.
- Select a skill to read SKILL.md, falling back to SKILL.toml.
- Enable, disable or delete local skills. Install built-in skills in an open project.
Plugins
- Manage plugins from the separate Plugins page.
System configuration
- Configure default project skill loading and prompt injection mode here.
- These settings do not remove the built-in skill list.

3. Fields
 auto_load_project_skills
- Boolean (true / false).
- true (default): delegated agents automatically load project and ancestor skills and .agents/skills.
- false: delegated agents load only skills explicitly selected in allowed_skills.
 prompt_injection_mode
- "compact" or "full".
- compact (default): inject metadata and load skill content as needed to save context.
- full: inject complete skill contents for compatibility, using more context.

4. Example
{
  "skills": {
    "auto_load_project_skills": true,
    "prompt_injection_mode": "compact"
  }
}

5. Enabling and disabling
- Local skills use a SKILL.disabled marker in the skill directory.
- Disabled skills stay visible in the catalog but are skipped at runtime, allowing later reactivation.

调度配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- scheduler 用于控制内置调度器的开关:
Scheduler configuration

1. Purpose
scheduler controls the built-in scheduler and its throughput limits, affecting scheduled task polling and concurrent execution.

2. Fields
enabled: enable the scheduler loop.
max_tasks: maximum tasks processed per poll.
max_concurrent: maximum tasks executed concurrently within a poll.

3. Example
{
  "scheduler": {
    "enabled": true,
    "max_tasks": 64,
    "max_concurrent": 4
  }
}

4. Recommendations
For long-running tasks, increase max_tasks first and avoid raising max_concurrent too quickly. Reduce max_concurrent when CPU or IO contention occurs.

自治配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- autonomy 控制代理执行权限边界、预算:
Autonomy configuration

1. Purpose
- autonomy controls agent execution permissions, budgets and approval policies.
- It affects shell commands, path access, non-CLI tool exposure and approval workflows.

2. Common fields
1) level
- read_only | supervised | full.
2) workspace_only
- When true, allow only workspace paths except allowed_roots.
3) allowed_commands / forbidden_paths
- Shell command allowlist and path denylist.
4) max_actions_per_hour / max_cost_per_day_cents
- Hourly action and daily cost limits.
5) require_approval_for_medium_risk / block_high_risk_commands
- Require approval for medium risk; block high-risk commands directly when configured.
- The shell quoted-newline restriction defaults to false; enabling it treats newlines inside shell quotes as injection and blocks them.
7) shell_redirect_policy
- block, strip or allow (default: execute unchanged).
8) non_cli_*
- Configure non-CLI tool exposure, approvers and natural-language approval modes.

3. Example
{
  "autonomy": {
    "level": "full",
    "workspace_only": false,
    "allowed_commands": [
      "git",
      "npm",
      "cargo",
      "ls",
      "cat",
      "grep",
      "find",
      "echo",
      "pwd",

常规设置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页控制桌面应用自身的显示、终端与预览体验，:
General settings

Purpose
Controls the desktop application's appearance, terminal and preview experience, without changing backend agent execution policies. Set long-term preferences such as theme, auto-save mode and terminal font here.

Main options
1) Application theme: overall desktop colors.
2) Auto save: when the preview editor saves automatically.
3) Terminal shell, theme, font and size: startup environment and readability of the built-in terminal.

Recommendations
Use the same shell as your usual development environment to reduce script differences. Prefer a monospaced font for reading terminal output. Choose a more conservative auto-save mode if the preview often saves unintentionally.
编辑器设置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页控制桌面编辑器的主题、字号与行高表现。:
Editor settings

Purpose
Controls the desktop editor's theme, font size and line height. These affect reading and editing, without changing file contents.

Main options
1) Follow system theme: automatically match the application theme.
2) Editor theme: used only when Follow system theme is off.
3) Font size, line height and automatic line height: together determine code density and readability.

Recommendations
For long coding sessions, adjust font size before deciding on automatic line height. Increase line height moderately for long lines or small screens to improve scanning.
项目设置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页管理桌面端最近项目入口、当前项目 Wor:
Project settings

Purpose
Manages recent project shortcuts, the current project's Worktree option and quick project opening. These settings affect only the local workflow and do not modify server model configuration.

Main options
1) Open folder: choose a workspace directory and switch the current project.
2) Current project Worktree: allow selecting or creating a Git worktree for new conversations.
3) Recent projects: rename display names, remove shortcuts or reopen projects.

Recommendations
Enable Worktree for projects that regularly need parallel branch development. Removing a recent-project shortcut does not delete its directory on disk.
模型提供商说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页管理模型提供商的连接状态、热门提供商接:
Model providers

Purpose
Manages provider connections, popular providers and custom provider entry points. The provider determines the model catalog, authentication and subsequent model choices.

Actions
1) Connected providers: view connections, change keys, edit or disconnect.
2) Popular providers: quickly connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and others from the catalog.
3) Custom providers: connect OpenAI-compatible endpoints or internal gateways.

Recommendations
Connect a provider first, then enable needed models on the Models page. Confirm the base URL, authentication headers and model ID naming rules before configuring a custom provider.
模型设置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页展示已连接提供商下的模型清单，并控制模型:
Model settings

Purpose
Lists models from connected providers and controls their availability in the application. Filter models, disable invalid ones and inspect capabilities here.

Actions
1) Refresh: fetch model lists from connected providers again.
2) Search: filter by provider name, model name or model ID.
3) Enable: include models in later selection and routing candidates.
4) More: inspect context length, tool calling and attachment support.
5) Multimodal: configure image count and size limits, remote fetching, direct image input and vision model understanding.

Recommendations
Keep only models you use to reduce clutter and accidental selection. Refresh after provider updates, then check enabled states.
智能体配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页统一管理各智能体的模型、提示词、工具权:
Agent configuration

Purpose
Manages each agent's model, prompts, tool permissions and execution boundaries, defining collaboration and capabilities for each role.

Areas
1) Agent list: select or create agents and inspect enabled states.
2) Basics: provider, model, compatibility mode, temperature and maximum iterations.
3) Prompt / Identity: edit system prompts and workspace identity files.
4) Tool permissions: allowed tools, parallelism and depth limits.
5) Conversation flow: reasoning summaries and default expansion of shell and editing tools.
6) Quick messages / Heartbeat: chat shortcuts, heartbeat interval, fallback message and delivery target.

Recommendations
Keep each agent's responsibilities clear and focused. Define role boundaries before customization to avoid overlapping capabilities.
通道配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页集中管理 CLI 与外部消息通道的启用状:
Channel configuration

Purpose
Manages enabled states, authentication and receiving modes for CLI and external messaging channels, including Telegram, Slack and Webhook integrations.

Areas
1) Global parameters: fixed project directory and message timeout budget.
2) Enabled channels: currently open entry points.
3) Channel panels: each channel independently maintains tokens, URLs, allowlists and group reply modes.

Recommendations
Expand and enable only channels in use to reduce configuration mistakes. After changing a sensitive token, verify a real end-to-end message flow.
记忆系统说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页控制记忆后端、保留策略、缓存、快照以及:
Memory system

Purpose
Controls the memory backend, retention, caches, snapshots and embedding retrieval, affecting long-term memory quality, disk usage and search results.

Areas
1) Basics: auto save, hygiene cleanup, response cache, snapshots and automatic restore.
2) Retention and cache: archive/cleanup days, SQLite timeout and cache capacity.
3) Embedding and retrieval: provider, model, dimensions and hybrid retrieval weights. Use hint:pattern-name to reference an Embedding routes rule.
4) Embedding routes: select providers, models, dimensions and API keys by matching pattern. Reference the route with hint:pattern-name in Embedding and retrieval.
5) Storage: PostgreSQL, MariaDB or SQLite and remote database connection parameters. Schema, tables, connection timeout and TLS mainly apply to remote SQL storage.
6) Qdrant: URL, collection and API key.

Recommendations
Match embedding dimensions to the vector index. Choose retention days first, then adjust cache capacity gradually to avoid unnecessary growth. For scenario-specific models, define an embedding route first and reference it with hint:pattern-name.
运行时配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页控制代理执行环境的类型，以及 Dock:
Runtime configuration

Purpose
Controls the agent execution environment and Docker / WASM resource and security boundaries. It determines tool isolation, performance costs and accessible resources.

Areas
1) Runtime kind: native, docker or wasm.
2) Docker: image, network, memory, CPU, read-only root filesystem and workspace mounts.
3) WASM: tool directory, fuel, memory, module size and host security policy.
4) Reasoning overrides: runtime hints such as reasoning_enabled / reasoning_level.

Recommendations
Prefer docker or wasm for high-risk tools and explicitly restrict read/write scope. After changing runtime kind, verify critical tool flows.
隧道配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页为网关配置公网暴露方式，支持 Cloud:
Tunnel configuration

Purpose
Exposes the local gateway using Cloudflare, Tailscale, ngrok or a custom command. A tunnel does not replace gateway authentication or rate limits.

Modes
1) cloudflare: managed tunnel using a Zero Trust token.
2) tailscale: serve within the tailnet or expose publicly with funnel.
3) ngrok: authentication token with an optional custom domain.
4) custom: integrate other tunnel tools with a launch command, health check and URL pattern.

Recommendations
Enable gateway authentication and pairing policies before public exposure. Test custom commands independently in a terminal first.
钩子配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页控制运行时 hooks 总开关、内置 h:
Hook configuration

Purpose
Controls the runtime hooks switch, built-in hooks and trusted plugin hooks. Hooks provide auditing, observability and workflow instrumentation rather than direct business logic.

Options
1) Master switch: pauses hook execution while retaining individual enabled states.
2) command_logger: records command calls for auditing and investigation.
3) Plugin review: inspect discovered events, commands, arguments, working directories and trust state. Trust or revoke submits only plugin IDs and server-reparsed stable hashes, not command contents.
4) Audit records: time, tool name, duration and success only; no arguments, result bodies, tokens or keys.

Recommendations
Enable the master switch before individual required hooks. Trust only plugins with clear origins and manually reviewed commands; review again when declarations change.
网页搜索配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- web_search 用于让代理主动检索:
Web search configuration

Purpose
Lets agents search public web results. Supported providers: duckduckgo, brave, serper, google and bing.

Fields
1) enabled / provider: enable the tool and choose a provider.
2) api_key / brave_api_key / api_url: authentication and optional compatible endpoint.
3) max_results / timeout_secs / user_agent: result count, request timeout and default request identification.

Recommendations
DuckDuckGo needs no API key; configure other provider keys as needed. Check protocol and authentication compatibility before using a custom api_url.
网络请求配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页控制 http_request 工具:
HTTP request configuration

Purpose
Controls http_request availability, external-request allowlists and limits. This is a network access boundary; avoid allowing all domains permanently.

Fields
1) Enable: allow calls to http_request.
2) Response size limit / timeout / User-Agent: resource limits and default request identification.
3) Allowed domains: the default `*` allows all public domains. An empty list denies all external requests.

Recommendations
Allow only required domains and avoid `*` where possible. Large responses increase memory use and model context costs.
浏览器配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- 本页控制 browser / browse:
Browser configuration

Purpose
Controls browser / browser_open availability, domain boundaries and automation backends, covering both simple page opening and system-level browser control.

Areas
1) Basics: enabled state, allowed domains, opening behavior, session name and backend. The default `*` allows all public domains. An empty list denies all sites.
2) Native backend: local Chrome/Chromium automation with WebDriver.
3) Computer Use backend: mouse, keyboard, screenshots and other system actions through a sidecar.

Recommendations
Restrict allowed_domains before enabling higher-permission backends. Enable computer_use.allow_remote_endpoint only within a trusted internal network.
代理配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- proxy 用于配置 VibeWindow:
Proxy configuration

Purpose
proxy configures VibeWindow HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxies. scope determines where they apply.

Fields
1) enabled: enable the proxy.
2) http_proxy / https_proxy / all_proxy: HTTP, HTTPS and fallback proxy addresses. Supports http/https/socks5/socks5h.
3) no_proxy: exclusions using NO_PROXY syntax.
4) scope: environment uses only system environment variables; vibewindow covers all VibeWindow-managed HTTP traffic; services applies only to selected services.
5) services: used with scope=services; examples include provider.openai, tool.http_request and channel.telegram.

Example
{
  "proxy": {
    "enabled": false,
    "http_proxy": null,
    "https_proxy": null,
    "all_proxy": null,
    "no_proxy": [],
    "scope": "vibewindow",
    "services": []
  }
}
可靠性配置说明\n\n1) provider_retries\n- 影响桌面聊天:
Reliability configuration

1) provider_retries
Applies to model requests from desktop chat, Gateway, Channel, Task Plan and ACP. After the first failure, only retryable transient errors trigger extra retries; total attempts are this value plus 1. Higher values improve recovery from transient faults but increase the wait before final failure; 0 disables extra retries. Saved settings affect new requests, not requests already executing or waiting.

2) provider_backoff_ms
Milliseconds before the first retry. Later retries use exponential backoff subject to a maximum wait. Larger values reduce request pressure during failures but slow recovery; smaller values retry sooner and may hit rate limits sooner.

3) channel_initial_backoff_secs
Seconds before the first reconnect after a channel listener disconnects. Larger values reduce frequent reconnects; smaller values recover sooner. Must not exceed maximum channel backoff. Channel backoff settings apply when listeners next start or restart.

4) channel_max_backoff_secs
Maximum reconnect delay after repeated failures. Larger values reduce pressure during extended outages; smaller values attempt recovery more often.

5) scheduler_poll_secs
Seconds between cron scans for due tasks. Smaller values discover tasks sooner with more polling overhead; larger values reduce overhead but may delay triggers. Applies when the cron scheduler next starts or restarts.

6) scheduler_retries
Additional retries after cron execution fails. Higher values improve recovery from transient failures but increase total execution time; 0 disables extra retries.

Default example
{
  "reliability": {
    "provider_retries": 3,
    "provider_backoff_ms": 500,
    "channel_initial_backoff_secs": 1,
    "channel_max_backoff_secs": 60,
    "scheduler_poll_secs": 60,
    "scheduler_retries": 3
  }
}
心跳配置说明\n\n一、作用\n- heartbeat 是一个“定时心跳任务”配:
Heartbeat configuration

Purpose
heartbeat defines a periodic heartbeat task triggered every interval_minutes. Each heartbeat first reads workspace HEARTBEAT.md tasks; message provides fallback instructions when no task is available.

Fields
1) enabled: boolean; false disables periodic triggers, true enables them.
2) interval_minutes: integer minutes between triggers; 30 means every 30 minutes. Suggested: 5–10 for testing, 15–60 in production.
3) message: string or null, fallback text when HEARTBEAT.md has no executable tasks. null supplies no fallback. Example: "Inspect services and summarize errors and alerts".
4) target: string or null, delivery channel such as telegram. null adds no delivery channel.
5) to: string or null, recipient chat_id / user_id / room_id, usually set together with target.

Examples
A: Local execution without delivery
{
  "heartbeat": {
    "enabled": true,
    "interval_minutes": 30,
    "message": "Check service health and pending work",
    "target": null,
    "to": null
  }
}

B: Deliver to telegram
{
  "heartbeat": {
    "enabled": true,
    "interval_minutes": 15,
    "message": "Report system status periodically",
    "target": "telegram",
    "to": "123456789"
  }
}

C: Current default structure
{
  "heartbeat": {
    "enabled": false,
    "interval_minutes": 30,
    "message": null,
    "target": null,
    "to": null
  }
}

Troubleshooting
Confirm enabled=true. Test with a short 1–5 minute interval. Set to when configuring target. Confirm Gateway availability and successful settings persistence. Restart after changes and inspect logs for heartbeat tick.

<type>[optional scope]: <summary>

Core commit types

feat: New functionality (minor version increase)
Example: feat(auth): add user login

fix: Bug fix (patch version increase)
Example: fix: correct home page image loading

docs: Documentation only
Example: docs: update API documentation

style: Code style without logic changes
Example: style: format code using ESLint

refactor: Restructure code without features or fixes
Example: refactor: simplify user lookup

perf: Performance improvement
Example: perf: cache list rendering

test: Add or update tests
Example: test: cover login

build: Build system or external dependencies
Example: build: upgrade webpack to v5

ci: CI configuration or scripts
Example: ci: add a Node matrix in GitHub Actions

chore: Maintenance outside source and tests
Example: chore: update npm dependencies

revert: Revert a previous commit
Example: revert: revert commit abc123

Extended and special types

init: Initialize project or scaffolding
config: Configuration changes
release: Release a version
deploy: Deployment
merge: Merge branches
wip: Work in progress (temporary commit; use carefully)
typo: Correct spelling
locale: Internationalization/localization
